title.urdu: روز جمعہ، عید فطر اور عید قربان امام عصر(عج) کے ظہور کی دُعا۔

desc.en: It is narrated from Imam Sadiq (a) that: On the day of resurrection, Allah (swt) will select the days and place the day of Friday, which will appear like a beautiful and exquisite bride that is gifted to a wealthy religious person, before all the other days. And the day of Friday (while having all the other days behind it) will stand in front of the Heaven s gate, and intercede for all those who recited numerous Salawaat on Mohammad (s) and his holy household (a). Abdullah bin Sanaan says: I asked: What does numerous Salawaat imply? And reciting Salawaat on which hours of Friday holds additional virtue? His holiness replied: One hundred times. Abdullah bin Sinaan asked: How should we recite Salawaat? He said: say…
desc.rurdu: Hazrat Imam Sadiq (a) farmate hai; Roz-e-Qayaamat Parwardigaar-e-Aalam dino (days) ko khaas shakl mein maboos karega aur Roz-e-Juma sab se aage hoga aur baqiya roz uske peechhe peechhe is tarah chal rahe honge jaise khoobsurat o ba-kamaal dulhan deen-daar o sarwat-mand shakhs ke ghar ja rahi ho aur behisht (Jannat) ke darwaazeke kinaare khade ho jaayenge, us roz jis ne bhi un dino (days) mein Muhammad (s) wa Aale Muhammad (a) par ziyadah salawaat bheji hai uski shafa’atkarenge. Ibne Sanaan ka bayaan hai; Ham ne arz kiya yahan ziyadah se muraad kita hai aur Roz-e-Juma kis waqt behtar hai? Hazrat (a) ne farmaya; 100 martaba aur behtar hai Asr ke waqt ho. Raawi ne arz kiya; kis tarah salawaat bheje? Imam (a) ne farmaya; 100 martaba kahe…
desc.urdu: حضرت امام محمد باقر فرماتے ہیں جمعہ عید فطر عید قربان کے دن جب نماز کے لئے جانے کا ارادہ کریں تو کہیں۔۔۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN WA AJJIL FARAJA-HUM.

trans.en: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and hasten their Relief.
trans.rurdu: Ay Ma’bood! Rehmat farma Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par aur unke Zuhoor mein taajil (jaldi) farma.
trans.urdu: اے معبود!محمد ؐ و آلِ محمدؑ پر رحمت فرما اور ان کے ظہور میں تعجیل عطافرما۔
